tools.name: tracepass_passport_parties
tools.description: Manage the economic-operator parties on a passport — manufacturer, importer, authorisedRepresentative, distributor, recycler, producerResponsibilityOrg. Each party carries a legal name and ideally a validated 13-digit GS1 GLN. Actions (pass via `action`, with `args`): - set — args: { id, role, legalName, gln?, country?, legacyOperatorId? }. Sets or updates one role. - remove — args: { id, role }. Clears one role.

prompts.name: audit_passport
prompts.description: Review one Digital Product Passport for completeness and compliance readiness — which required fields are missing, which economic-operator parties are unset, whether it's publishable.

prompts.name: onboard_product
prompts.description: Walk through creating a new product and its first Digital Product Passport — gathering the details, then creating both.

prompts.name: explain_dpp_requirements
prompts.description: Explain what a Digital Product Passport in a given category must contain to be compliant — the required fields and the EU regulation behind them — before you create anything.

prompts.name: compliance_gap_check
prompts.description: Cross-check a draft passport against its category's regulatory schema and produce an exact, prioritised list of what's missing before it can be published compliantly.

prompts.name: review_epcis_events
prompts.description: Inspect the EPCIS 2.0 supply-chain event history of a passport and summarise the product's traceability story.
